transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Well... it's my sleep, mostly. It's become completely unmoored. For a while, I was waking up after maybe two or three hours... I'd just get up and start drafting plans, feeling ready to go. But now I just... I lie awake before dawn. My stomach gets tight. I don't get any sense of rest from it anymore.
Do you feel anxious most of the time?
I'm not sure I'd use that word. I just... I feel the tightness in the mornings, like I said. I haven't really thought about whether it's anxiety.
Do you often feel extremely tired during the day?
I... well, I wouldn't say extremely tired. I don't really do much of anything during the day right now, so... I haven't really noticed.
Do you have bad dreams?
No... not really. I don't really remember them.
Do you feel sad most of the time?
I... no, I don't think so. I don't really know how to describe it, but... I wouldn't use the word sad. I just kind of... get through the day, I suppose.
Do you find pleasure in activities you used to enjoy?

I... no. Not really. I used to do things—spend afternoons at the museum, photography, cooking... but lately, if I look at my camera, or the bridge table... I just don't feel anything. It's... it would just be an effort to pretend, I suppose.
Do you often feel guilty about things?

I... yes. I suppose I do. I... I'd rather not go into all the details, but... I just keep replaying this investment decision I made. Over and over. I... I feel like I've completely ruined my wife's financial security. I spent my whole life being the responsible one, and... I just made a fool of myself. So... yes. It's hard not to think about that.
How long have you been feeling this way?
I... well, it's been a while now. About nine months, I think. Ever since those... those investment plans fell apart. That's when this all started.
Have you had any periods in the past nine months where you felt completely back to normal?
I... no. I don't think so. It's just been... well, just like this. Every day. I haven't really felt like myself at all.
Do you feel like you've lost interest in things you used to enjoy recently?

I... yes. I suppose so. 

I used to... well, I'd spend whole afternoons at the museum. Or I'd get lost in photography, or... or cooking. But lately... I don't know. I just look at my camera, or the bridge table, and... I don't feel anything. It just feels like... like it would take too much effort even to pretend.
Have you had a period of at least two weeks where you felt depressed nearly every day?
I... I'm not sure. I haven't really kept track of the weeks like that. It just... it all sort of blends together. I don't know if I would use that exact word for it.
Have you had any periods in the past few months where you felt significantly better for a while?
No... I don't think so. Like I said, it's just... it's all been the same. I haven't really noticed any change.
Have you had more than one period in your life where you felt this way?
I... I don't know. It's hard to remember. I just... I don't think I can say for sure.
Have you felt this way at any point in your life before the past nine months?
I... I really couldn't say. That's a long time to look back on. It just gets a bit foggy, honestly. I don't remember.
Have you ever felt this way before in your life, prior to the past nine months?
I thought I just... I really don't know. Like I said, I can't give you a straight answer on that. It's just too far back to be sure.
Have you ever had a period in your life where you felt similar to how you've been feeling over the past nine months, but it got better on its own or with treatment?
I... I mean, I don't think so. I just... I can't really recall. Things sort of blend together, you know? I just don't have a clear answer for you.
Have you ever felt this way before in your life and then gotten better?

Look... I don't know what else to tell you. Like I've been saying, I just don't remember. If I did feel this way before and got better, I... I don't recall it. I don't have a different answer for you.
Have you ever had an episode like this in your life before the past nine months that lasted for a while and then went away?
You are asking me the exact same thing again. I... I don't know why you keep asking it. My answer hasn't changed in the last two minutes. I just don't remember.
Have you ever had an episode of feeling this way that lasted for a while and then went away before the past nine months?
I... I really don't know what you want me to say at this point. We just went over this. I don't remember. Please, can we just move on?
